## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The lint reports **0 findings**: `bash implementation/mos/.claude/hooks/lint.sh`
- [ ] One PR, one idea — this is a single coherent change.
- [ ] If I touched the English README, `Manifesto`, or `QUICKSTART`, or the default MOS (`implementation/mos/`), I flagged the French counterpart so the maintainers can regenerate it (the French set is a derived translation, never edited on its own).
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, or local config in the diff.
